nodes.description: In Drosophila, Gdap2 expression changes after stress, and ubiquitous Gdap2 knockdown makes flies die much sooner on paraquat (oxidative stress) and slightly sooner on starvation. The authors propose that defective stress handling contributes to the neurological phenotype. Cleaved-caspase-3 staining did not show increased neurodegeneration in knockdown fly brains, so the authors read the reduced survival as neuronal dysfunction rather than cell loss at that stage. This node rests on invertebrate data only.
